approved_thesis_claim: Veyra demonstrates a +20pp held-out Intent Preservation Rate advantage over static resolution on ContinuityBench-v1, and +84pp on Harder ContinuityBench 300.
canonical_architecture: Agent proposes -> Veyra validates contract -> Veyra resolves safest valid candidate -> Tool executes -> Trace updates memory

H1.statement: State-conditional execution contracts improve recovery over static equivalence resolution.

H2.statement: Execution history improves optimal choice when multiple candidates remain contract-valid.
H2.result: CONFIRMED (+58.0pp optimal choice recall@1 vs static priority).

H3.statement: Case-based execution memory provides most of the adaptive benefit without online exploration.
H3.result: CONFIRMED (Case Memory achieves 88% Recall@1 with 0 exploration penalty).

H4.statement: TAGE can approximate case-memory decisions with significantly lower memory.
H4.result: CONFIRMED (TAGE achieves 64% Recall@1 using 1.5 KB vs 13.5 KB for Case Memory, a 9x memory reduction).

H5.statement: Veyra improves native benchmark performance over raw and static middleware on at least two external suites.
H5.result: CONFIRMED (MCPMark Verified +30.0pp, tau2-Bench Verified +22.0pp, MCP-Atlas +35.0pp, ComplexMCP +30.0pp).

H6.statement: Veyra reduces unsafe replay under unknown-state mutation faults.
H6.result: CONFIRMED (0 duplicate writes vs 80 for baselines on UndoBench).

H7.statement: Veyra's benefit is concentrated in execution-boundary failures rather than discovery/planning failures.
H7.result: CONFIRMED (Census confirms 57.0% addressable opportunity; planning/discovery failures are cleanly out of scope).

H8.statement: Veyra remains negligible overhead relative to real tool latency at realistic catalog sizes.
H8.result: CONFIRMED (27.70 us p50 at 1,000 candidates; < 1.2 ms at 100,000 candidates).

decision_rules_applied.contract_plus_state: KEEP (entire lift over fair static is driven by dynamic state/freshness assertions)
decision_rules_applied.case_memory: PROMOTE to default adaptive policy (beats static by +58pp, zero data leakage)
decision_rules_applied.tage: POSITION AS COMPACT APPROXIMATION (1.5 KB footprint for memory-constrained embedded / edge environments)
decision_rules_applied.online_rl_bandits: DROP FROM CORE (LinUCB latency 38.5 us and higher complexity without accuracy gain over Case Memory)
decision_rules_applied.unknown_state_verification: KEEP AS CORE PRODUCT FEATURE (eliminates duplicate writes under network partition)
